scope: Remove stored-field scanning for stored-only and term-vector-only fields. Continue listing actual index field names and their resolved types, but return docCount=null, countAccuracy=unavailable, and a clear countSource when no supported indexed presence structure can provide a safe count. Preserve exact query counts for supported indexed, DocValues, vector, and point fields, the live q+fq domain, and local-core scope. Do not add field statistics, facets, pivots, a JIRA issue, or a public PR. Windows must not run Gradle or tests; push the branch and prepare exact-head Linux proof.
summary: Avoid scans for fields without an indexed presence structure
